title: AgentProfile
description: A named worker (or a whole swarm): a role (model tier) + the capabilities it may use + its skills. A 'manager' profile also carries 'managed' sub-profiles it may delegate to. Pure data every product can build and extend; a product's runtime turns it into a governed agent run. The canonical byte serialization is a signable, portable artifact exactly like a Skill.

role.description: Model tier; overridden by an explicit model pin.

tools.description: Capability ids this profile may use (its own; its skills' tools are added at runtime).

managed.description: Sub-workers a manager delegates to (orchestrator-workers). Recursive.

model.description: Explicit model pin; overrides role tiering.

node.description: Preferred node to run on; the product routes to it.

persona.description: System voice seeded ahead of the task.

mode.description: manager = delegate to 'managed'; sequential = run skills in order.
